name: koekomi
description: コエコミ — 声でつくる4コマ劇場。小学生向けイベント用 Web アプリ (monorepo)

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.fix: npm run format && npm run lint:fix && npm run lint:py:fix
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:py
scripts.lint:py: bash scripts/py.sh ruff check backend colab
scripts.lint:py:fix: bash scripts/py.sh ruff check backend colab --fix
scripts.format:py: bash scripts/py.sh ruff format backend colab
scripts.format:py:check: bash scripts/py.sh ruff format --check backend colab
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:py
